descripcion: A security vulnerability has been detected in xuxueli xxl-job 3.5.0/3.5.1-SNAPSHOT. The affected element is the function insert/update of the file admin/src/main/java/com/xxl/job/admin/business/controller/JobGroupController.java of the component Group Management. The manipulation of the argument addressList leads to cross-site request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible.
